scenes.headline: Myth or fact?
scenes.narration: You have heard all three of these. Let us check what the evidence actually says.

scenes.headline: Myth: we use ten percent of our brain
scenes.narration: Brain scans show activity across the whole brain over a day. There is no dormant ninety percent.

stat.label: of the brain we supposedly use

scenes.headline: Myth: cracking knuckles gives arthritis
scenes.narration: Studies that looked for a link have not found one. The popping is gas bubbles in the joint fluid.

scenes.headline: Myth: sugar makes kids hyper
scenes.narration: Controlled trials found no effect on behaviour. Parents often expect it, and that expectation changes what they see.

scenes.headline: Share with a skeptic
scenes.narration: Know someone who still believes one of these? Send them this and follow for more myth checks.
